## Overview

The unsigned Claude chain-of-thought (CoT) capture+replay over the `/chat/completions`
transport (D-001) ships today with **parser/payload unit tests** but **no deterministic
end-to-end test** that drives a full agentic turn through a mounted mock server and verifies the
*capture → persist → replay* loop plus typed `function_call` assembly and usage accounting. This
plan adds that test, mirroring the existing `core_test_support::responses` harness (the `/responses`
mock-SSE path) for the chat path.

**What changed since the 2026-06-24 draft (why this refresh exists).** The original plan framed
this e2e as "the operator's gating verification before deciding whether to build the signed
`/v1/messages` transport." That decision has been made and **the signed-CoT native Anthropic
Messages (`/v1/messages`) transport has SHIPPED** (codex wrapper `ed44c1d0`, inner `16175abdc0`;
`docs/implementation/patch-surface.md` §14 invariants **63–68**). The unsigned `/chat/completions`
path now **coexists in production with** the signed `/v1/messages` path — and is its **degrade
target** (a messages-routed model with the signed sub-gate off falls back to `/chat/completions`).
So this e2e is no longer a go/no-go gate for a future transport; it is the **overdue deterministic
coverage for a transport that is already live in production**, and it must now also prove the routing
decision lands on `/chat/completions` rather than the new `/v1/messages` arm. The refresh: (a) updated
framing, (b) the new **dual-gate routing** dimension in US-003's setup, (c) a new "egress hits
`/chat/completions`, not `/v1/messages`" assertion, (d) a **test-home recommendation flip** to
`core/tests/suite/chat_completions.rs` (the location `patch-surface.md` invariant 37 already names),
and (e) refreshed file:line citations (verified 2026-06-27 — see each section).

It is a **test-only** addition, but not trivial. Three structural facts shape the plan:
1. The fork's Copilot-session test side-channel (`configure_copilot_session_for_tests` /
   `CopilotSessionFixture`) was removed in the v0.140.0 rebase and never re-committed (tracked as
   `codex-rebase-debt-fix-client-copilot-fixture`). The full-loop e2e needs Copilot-session
   enablement — but this plan rebuilds only a **test-only `COPILOT_API_HOME` token-cache fixture**
   (zero production change), not a production seam.
2. A **Cargo dependency cycle** (`codex-copilot → core_test_support → codex-core → codex-copilot`)
   means the full `test_codex`-driven e2e **cannot** live in `codex-copilot`. The recommended home
   is **`core/tests/suite/chat_completions.rs`** (codex-core's own integration-test dir — downstream
   of everything, no cycle, no preflight; the file `patch-surface.md` invariant 37 already references).
3. Because a wiremock-driven full-loop test `skip_if_no_network!`-skips in the codex sandbox (and
   `gim-home` CI is org-policy-blocked), the plan is **risk-ordered so the central assertions are
   verifiable WITHOUT network first** (US-001 strengthens existing inline tests — the gated ACs),
   then builds the operator's headline multi-turn e2e as a network-gated capstone
   (US-002 harness foundation → US-003 e2e, run outside the sandbox with evidence pasted).

- `ModelWireRoute::AnthropicMessages` + parent ON + signed ON → `WireApi::AnthropicMessages` (signed `/v1/messages`).

**Implication for US-008:** to exercise the unsigned `/chat/completions` path the test must drive
the routing to `WireApi::ChatCompletions`: set the **parent gate ON and the signed sub-gate OFF**,
and use a model whose `wire_route` is `ChatCompletions` (cleanest), OR `AnthropicMessages` with the
signed sub-gate off (the degrade path). The signed sub-gate default is OFF, so the main new
requirement is simply *don't enable it* (and assert the egress path is `/chat/completions`).

### Technical Constraints

1. **Dependency cycle blocks `codex-copilot` as the e2e home.** `codex-copilot`'s deps do NOT include
   `codex-core`; dev-depending on `core_test_support` forms `codex-copilot → core_test_support →
   codex-core → codex-copilot`, which Cargo rejects. So the full `test_codex` e2e must live downstream
   of core: **`core/tests/suite/` (recommended — codex-core's own dev-dep, no cycle, no preflight)**, or
   a new overlay leaf crate (alternative — see Architecture).
2. **Copilot-session test enablement does not exist.** `stream_chat_completions` unconditionally does
   `CopilotAuth::new()` (`auth.rs:102`, reads token cache) and `CopilotHeaderSource::new(auth).await`
   (`header_source.rs:27`) — independent of the mock `base_url` (the provider `base_url` only redirects
   the chat POST target, NOT auth). **However, `build_cached_headers` (`header_source.rs:89`) calls
   `auth.copilot_token(/*force_refresh*/ false)` (`:90`), which short-circuits with NO network and
   returns the cached token whenever `read_cached_copilot_token()` yields a token with `expires_at >
   now+60` (`auth.rs:173-177`).** Therefore **seeding a fake on-disk Copilot token cache with a
   far-future `expires_at` in an isolated app dir makes `CopilotAuth::new()` + the header source
   succeed fully offline, with zero production edit** (Option A — the committed approach). An injectable
   seam (Option B) is a true fallback only.
3. **Two process-global gates (`install_anthropic_gate` + `install_anthropic_signed_messages_gate`,
   both `AtomicBool`) and the overlay `CODEX_ENABLE_ANTHROPIC` `OnceLock` (`gate.rs:5`).** Existing
   model-provider tests call `install_anthropic_gate(true)` / `install_anthropic_signed_messages_gate(...)`
   directly (`copilot_models_endpoint.rs:633/657/667`). Gate state cannot be flipped per-test inside a
   shared binary — set both once at the binary/env level and keep all chat tests that need them in one
   binary. **Gate-ordering trap:** both gates are re-derived from `Feature::*` during
   `test_codex().build()` (`config/mod.rs:2832` and `:2835`), so a bare `install_anthropic_gate(true)`
   BEFORE `build()` is silently reset. Enable the features in the builder config before `build()`, OR
   call the `install_*` functions AFTER `build()` and before the first submitted turn.
4. **Same-chunk ordering (one assertion) is not assertable through a plain wiremock body.** The fix
   lives in `drain_chat_chunk` feeding both parsers anthropic-first per raw network read
   (`chat_transport.rs:423`); wiremock does not control TCP read splits. It is already covered by the
   direct single-buffer unit test (`chat_transport.rs:1174`). Any added coverage must use a direct
   `AnthropicSseParser::push` single-buffer test or the deterministic `streaming_sse.rs` server, never
   a plain wiremock response.
5. **No aggregate byte cap exists in the replay path.** `payload.rs` enforces the 8000-byte cap PER
   ITEM only; the cross-turn budget is delegated to history/compaction (a token cap, ≤10K tokens/item
   per codex AGENTS.md "Model visible context"), not a byte cap here. The original "per-item +
   AGGREGATE BYTE cap" phrasing does not match the code. See Open Questions.
6. **`reasoning_text` capture is not gated by `reasoning_effort` at the parser level.** The parser
   captures whatever `reasoning_text` the wire carries; `reasoning_effort` gates the *outgoing* request
   (top-level field) that makes Copilot emit CoT. The e2e asserts the turn-1 outgoing body carries
   `reasoning_effort` AND the mock's `reasoning_text` is captured.
7. **Conflict-surface discipline** (codex `CLAUDE.md` tenet 1). The recommended home
   (`core/tests/suite/chat_completions.rs` + `core/tests/common/chat_sse.rs`) adds a small,
   fork-added-for-fork-feature surface: one new suite file + one `mod chat_completions;` line in
   `core/tests/suite/mod.rs` + one `pub mod chat_sse;` line in `core/tests/common/lib.rs` (and a
   matching `core/tests/common/Cargo.toml` dep on `codex-copilot`/`wiremock` if not already present).
   Every `codex-rs` edit carries a `// SANDBOX PATCH:` marker; add a patch-surface.md §14/§15 entry
   only if a guarded invariant is introduced (none expected — this CLOSES the gap behind invariant 37,
   it does not add a new invariant). The alternative leaf-crate route instead edits `codex-rs/Cargo.toml`
   (workspace member) — comparable surface, plus an unverified `core_test_support`-reachability preflight.
8. **Platform/runtime + test-runner isolation (MEDIUM — load-bearing for the process-global gate).**
   Tests must pass on Linux + macOS + Windows. The anthropic gate is a process-global `AtomicBool`
   **re-derived on every `test_codex().build()`**, and `core/tests/all.rs` aggregates all suite tests
   into ONE binary — every concurrent suite test's `build()` installs the gate OFF. The chat e2e is
   safe ONLY because the repo's runner is **`cargo-nextest`** (`.config/nextest.toml`), which runs each
   test in its OWN process; under plain `cargo test` (single shared process) a parallel non-chat
   `build()` would clobber the gate to OFF mid-run → flaky misroute to Responses. So: run the e2e via
   `just test` / nextest (NOT bare `cargo test`); install the gate AFTER `build()` immediately before
   the first turn; and if it must ever run under libtest, add a `#[serial_test::serial(anthropic_gate)]`-style
   guard. (CI runs `cargo test --workspace` per `invariant-check`, but the e2e is `skip_if_no_network!`
   and skips there, so the shared-process risk does not bite in CI.) Local verification: `cargo check
   --workspace` (~6 min) + `just test -p codex-copilot` and `-p codex-core`; do NOT run `cargo test
   --workspace` locally (90+ min); `just fmt` after edits.

## Approach

### Architecture

Three concerns, mapped to their cheapest cycle-safe + lowest-risk home:

1. **Per-item replay + 8000-byte cap, reasoning-effort present/absent (US-001)** → strengthen the
   inline `#[cfg(test)]` tests in **`codex-copilot/src/payload.rs`** (`:729/:744/:767/:800/:856`). Pure
   `build_chat_request_body`, no server, no cycle, lives next to the logic.
2. **Parser-level capture / typed `function_call` / usage / same-chunk ordering (US-001 cite-and-confirm)**
   → already covered by existing `#[cfg(test)]` tests: `anthropic_sse.rs:692` (reasoning capture),
   `chat_transport.rs:1174` (ordering), `chat_completions.rs:274/:324/:364` (typed tool-call assembly +
   usage). US-008 **cites and confirms** these by exact test name + `just test -p <crate>` command, and
   adds a new direct single-buffer test ONLY for a named gap.
3. **The genuine FULL multi-turn agentic e2e** (drive the turn loop, capture turn-1 reasoning into
   history, run a tool round, observe the turn-2 outgoing chat body, assert the replayed reasoning
   survives a real second turn, assert egress is `/chat/completions`) → **`core/tests/suite/chat_completions.rs`**
   (RECOMMENDED), with the reusable chat-SSE mock in `core/tests/common/chat_sse.rs`.

**Test-home recommendation (refreshed — flips the 2026-06-24 default).** Prefer
**`core/tests/suite/chat_completions.rs`** over the new overlay leaf crate, because:
- `patch-surface.md` invariant 37 (typed `function_call` assembly) **already names
  `core/tests/suite/chat_completions.rs`** as the "core deterministic e2e" verification location — it
  simply does not exist yet. Creating it closes a documented gap and aligns verification with the
  invariant ledger. (The invariant lives in the WRAPPER doc `codex/docs/implementation/patch-surface.md`
  — `codex-patched/docs/...` does NOT contain it; no doc edit is expected, the gap is just closed.)
- It is codex-core's own test target, so it reaches `test_codex` + `core_test_support` with **no
  dependency cycle and no `core_test_support`-reachability preflight** (the leaf-crate route's
  unverified risk).
- Surface is comparable-to-lower than the leaf crate: a suite file + two registration lines, vs a new
  crate + a `codex-rs/Cargo.toml` workspace-member edit (also upstream-canonical) + the preflight.
- **Alternative (documented, not recommended): the overlay leaf crate
  `codex/codex-rs-overlay/codex-copilot-e2e-tests/`** (mirror `codex-invariant-tests`: `publish = false`,
  own `tests/`, workspace-member entry in `codex-rs/Cargo.toml`). Choose it only if the team explicitly
  prefers to keep the suite dir free of this test; it trades the suite `mod` line for a Cargo.toml
  member edit and re-introduces the `core_test_support` dev-dep preflight (resolve via `cargo metadata`
  before building US-003 on it).

**Verifiability layering (critical — addresses the no-in-loop-gate risk).** The codex sandbox
disables localhost TCP (so any wiremock full-loop test `skip_if_no_network!`-skips locally) and the
`gim-home` `invariant-check` CI is currently org-policy-blocked (`escalate-gim-home-actions-policy`),
so a *network-gated* test provides NO autonomously-verifiable gate. Therefore the plan makes the
**central assertions verifiable WITHOUT network** and treats the wiremock multi-turn loop as an
*additional* integration capstone:
- **No-network gated assertions (run everywhere, the real ACs):** drive `build_chat_request_body`
  DIRECTLY to assert reasoning replay-into-body + the per-item 8000-byte truncation (concern 1);
  cite/confirm the DIRECT parser tests for reasoning capture, same-chunk ordering, typed
  `function_call` assembly, and usage (concern 2). These need no server and are the gated ACs.
- **Network-gated integration capstone (additional confidence):** the wiremock-driven full multi-turn
  `test_codex` loop, which proves the capture→persist→input→replay chain end-to-end AND that routing
  lands on `/chat/completions`. It carries `skip_if_no_network!`; the impl member runs it OUTSIDE the
  sandbox and pastes the passing output as evidence (it is not the sole gate for any AC).

Copilot-session enablement (needed by concern 3) — **committed approach: Option A** (test-only, zero
production change), with Option B as a true fallback:
- **Option A (committed): seed a fake on-disk Copilot token cache** with a far-future `expires_at` in
  an isolated app dir, and point the provider `base_url` at the wiremock server so the chat POST is
  captured. Feasible against source: `build_cached_headers` (`header_source.rs:89-90`) →
  `auth.copilot_token(false)` (`auth.rs:170-177`) returns the cached token with NO network when
  `expires_at > now+60`. The fixture sets+RESTORES **`COPILOT_API_HOME`** (`paths.rs:16`; fallback
  `~/.local/share/copilot-api`) to a temp dir and seeds `copilot_token` there (NO `github_token`).
- **Option B (fallback only): a process-global, test-only override in `codex-copilot`** (re-using the
  `configure_copilot_session_for_tests` name) that installs a fake static-bearer `CopilotHeaderSource`
  and signals `stream_chat_completions` to skip the real `CopilotAuth::new()`. Single inert consuming
  branch in `core/src/chat_transport.rs`; `// SANDBOX PATCH:` + a patch-surface note. Use ONLY if
  Option A's `COPILOT_API_HOME` isolation proves infeasible.

### Implementation Strategy

Risk-ordered. **US-001 delivers the verifiable no-network coverage first** (the gated ACs), then
US-002→US-003 build the operator's headline multi-turn capstone. US-001 is independent; US-002 and
US-003 are serial.

1. **US-001 — No-network deterministic assertions (the gated ACs; extend EXISTING inline tests, no
   new test file / no network / no auth / no production change).**
   - Strengthen `build_chat_body_caps_oversized_replayed_reasoning` (`payload.rs:856`) to assert the
     exact 8000-byte tail on the UTF-8 char boundary + the `[earlier reasoning truncated]\n` marker
     (do NOT add a duplicate test).
   - Strengthen the replay tests (`build_chat_body_replays_reasoning_as_standalone_assistant_message`
     `:767`, `persisted_reasoning_item_reaches_chat_request_body` `:800`) so a non-truncating reasoning
     item replays verbatim as an `{"role":"assistant","content":...}` message in `build_chat_request_body`
     output.
   - Pin `reasoning_effort` present/absent via the existing `build_chat_body_sets_reasoning_effort_when_selected`
     (`:729`) and `build_chat_body_omits_reasoning_effort_when_absent` (`:744`). Drop the ambiguous
     "gate-off" wording (the gates are process-global and awkward to flip).
   - Cite/confirm parser-level coverage (add a direct single-buffer test ONLY for a named gap):
     reasoning capture `anthropic_sse.rs:692`; same-chunk ordering `chat_transport.rs:1174`; typed
     `function_call` assembly + usage `chat_completions.rs:274/:324/:364`.
   - Verify: `just test -p codex-copilot` + `just test -p codex-core`.
2. **US-002 — Capstone foundation: chat-SSE mock harness + Option A token-cache fixture (in
   `core/tests/common/`).**
   - New `core/tests/common/chat_sse.rs`: a chat-SSE mock that mounts **`POST /v1/chat/completions`**
     (NOT `/chat/completions` — `test_codex.rs:369` sets provider `base_url` to `{server}/v1` and
     `send_chat_request` appends `/chat/completions`), `ev_chat_*` builders (content delta,
     `reasoning_text` delta, tool_call, finish_reason, usage chunk, `[DONE]`), and a `ChatRequest`
     body-capture with accessors (`messages()`, the replayed assistant reasoning message,
     `reasoning_effort()`, and a `path()`/url accessor to assert `/v1/chat/completions`). Register via
     `pub mod chat_sse;` in `core/tests/common/lib.rs`. **No new manifest dep is expected:**
     `core_test_support`'s `Cargo.toml` ALREADY depends on `wiremock`, `tokio`, `tempfile`,
     `serde_json`, `codex-core`, `codex-protocol`, `codex-model-provider-info`, and `codex-features`
     (verified). Add `codex-copilot` ONLY if the token-cache fixture reuses its cache types — prefer
     writing the cache JSON directly to avoid the extra dep (no new cycle either way, since
     `codex-copilot` does not depend on `core_test_support`).
   - Option A token-cache fixture (test-only, co-located with the harness): set+RESTORE
     **`COPILOT_API_HOME`** to a temp dir and write a `copilot_token` file. **`CachedCopilotToken`
     (`auth.rs:74-78`) has NO serde defaults** — the fixture must write ALL THREE fields:
     `token` (any non-empty string), `expires_at` (far-future epoch seconds), and `refresh_in`
     (any u64) — or `read_cached_copilot_token` fails with "decoding cached Copilot token". Do NOT
     write a `github_token` (forcing the cached-token short-circuit). This makes `CopilotAuth::new()` +
     `CopilotHeaderSource::new()` succeed offline with zero production edit.
   - (Alternative home only) If the leaf crate is chosen instead, run the `core_test_support`
     dev-dep `cargo metadata` preflight FIRST and create the crate + workspace-member entry; otherwise
     this story has no preflight.
3. **US-003 — Capstone: the full multi-turn wiremock `test_codex` e2e (`core/tests/suite/chat_completions.rs`;
   network-gated; run OUTSIDE the sandbox).**
   - Setup (model override — **do NOT pass a `claude-*` slug**): the bundled test catalog
     (`models-manager/models.json`) is **GPT-only** (`gpt-5.5/5.4/5.4-mini/5.3-codex/5.2/codex-auto-review`),
     and `with_model_info_override(model, …)` (`test_codex.rs:283`) does
     `.find(|m| m.slug == model).expect("model should exist in the configured model catalog")` — so
     passing `claude-sonnet-4.6`/`claude-opus-4.8` **PANICS**. Routing depends only on `wire_route` + the
     gates (NOT the slug), and `test_codex` uses the **openai** provider so the Copilot-side
     `wire_route_for` re-derivation does not run — the overridden `wire_route` survives to
     `client.rs:1634`. So override an EXISTING bundled slug and shape it like a synthesized Claude chat
     row: `with_model_info_override("gpt-5.2", |mi| { mi.wire_route = ModelWireRoute::ChatCompletions;
     mi.supports_reasoning_summaries = false; mi.default_reasoning_level = Some(<level>); })`
     (`test_codex.rs:283`; two-arg `(model: &str, FnOnce(&mut ModelInfo))` form). **`supports_reasoning_summaries
     = false` is load-bearing:** `client.rs:1690-1700` shows core's `build_reasoning` strips the
     `reasoning` object for `supports_reasoning_summaries=false` rows and the SANDBOX-PATCH chat arm
     threads `reasoning_effort` explicitly — set it `false` (as synthesized Claude rows do,
     `openai_models.rs:802`) so the e2e exercises that explicit threading path, not the responses-body
     reasoning. Alternatively, inject a custom `config.model_catalog` row mimicking a synthesized Claude
     chat row. Then: **parent gate ON, signed sub-gate OFF** + the Option A
     fixture + provider `base_url` → wiremock. **Gate-ordering is load-bearing:** enable
     `Feature::AnthropicModels` (and leave `Feature::AnthropicSignedMessages` OFF) in the
     `TestCodexBuilder` config BEFORE `build()`, OR call `install_anthropic_gate(true)` +
     `install_anthropic_signed_messages_gate(false)` AFTER `build()` and before the first turn — NOT a
     bare `install_anthropic_gate(true)` before `build()` (`config/mod.rs:2832` resets it). With the
     signed sub-gate off, a `ChatCompletions`-route model routes to `/chat/completions` (and a
     messages-route model would degrade to it).
   - Turn 1: mock returns `reasoning_text` deltas + a `tool_call` + a usage chunk; assert the turn-1
     outgoing body carries `reasoning_effort`; assert the reasoning is captured into history.
   - Tool round → Turn 2: assert the turn-2 outgoing body's `messages[]` carries the replayed reasoning
     (continuity), plus typed `function_call` assembly (name/args/call_id) and usage (input/output tokens).
   - **NEW assertion (routing — assert at the SERVER level, not the chat-mock level):** enumerate
     `server.received_requests().await` and assert NO request path matches `/v1/messages` AND ≥1 matches
     `/v1/chat/completions` (optionally also mount a `/v1/messages` recorder stub and assert it got ZERO
     hits). A chat-mock `path()` accessor alone is **tautological** — a misroute to `/v1/messages` would
     404 against the unmounted route and never be captured, so "every *captured* request hit
     `/v1/chat/completions`" is true by construction and proves nothing. The server-level check is what
     actually proves the dual-gate routing picked the unsigned chat path.
   - Guard with `skip_if_no_network!()`; the impl member runs it OUTSIDE the sandbox and pastes the
     passing output as evidence. This is the operator's headline e2e but is NOT the sole gate for any AC.

## Scope

### In Scope
- Copilot-session test enablement via Option A: an isolated `COPILOT_API_HOME` temp dir seeded with a
  future-`expires_at` `copilot_token` so `stream_chat_completions` runs against a wiremock server with
  no live token exchange and no production edit.
- A chat-SSE mock harness (mount `POST /v1/chat/completions` + scripted SSE + outbound-body capture
  with a path accessor).
- The deterministic multi-turn e2e at `core/tests/suite/chat_completions.rs` (the patch-surface
  invariant-37 home), with the overlay leaf crate documented as the alternative.
- No-network deterministic assertions (the gated ACs) by STRENGTHENING existing inline tests, plus the
  network-gated multi-turn e2e capstone, together asserting: (1) reasoning capture turn-1, (2) replay
  continuity turn-2 + per-item 8000-byte truncation, (3) same-chunk ordering (cite/confirm existing),
  (4) typed `function_call` assembly + usage, (5) no `/responses` regression AND egress is
  `/chat/completions` not `/v1/messages` (the routing-decision assertion).
- `// SANDBOX PATCH:` markers on the new `core/tests/{common,suite}` files + registration lines.

### Out of Scope
- Any change to the transport's production behavior (capture, replay, caps, routing, gates).
- The signed `/v1/messages` transport itself (already shipped; invariants 63–68). This e2e only
  asserts the unsigned path is selected, not the signed path's behavior.
- A true *aggregate* byte cap (does not exist; adding one is a production change).
- Asserting history/compaction's token-based aggregate context cap end-to-end (different subsystem).
- Broadening any crate's public (non-test) API surface.

## Risk Areas
- **`COPILOT_API_HOME`, not `CODEX_HOME` (the #1 auth trap).** `CopilotAuth::new()` resolves its app
  dir from `AppPaths::from_env()` which reads **`COPILOT_API_HOME`** (`paths.rs:16`; fallback
  `~/.local/share/copilot-api`) — NOT `CODEX_HOME`. Seeding the wrong env both fails to satisfy auth
  hermetically AND risks reading the developer's real Copilot cache. The fixture must set + RESTORE
  `COPILOT_API_HOME` and seed `copilot_token` there.
- **`/v1/chat/completions`, not `/chat/completions`.** `test_codex.rs:369` sets provider `base_url` to
  `{server}/v1`; `chat_completions.rs:31` appends `/chat/completions`. The mock must mount
  `/v1/chat/completions` (or the fixture overrides `config.model_provider.base_url`). Wrong path = the
  test silently exercises nothing.
- **Dual-gate routing trap (NEW since 2026-06-24).** Routing now AND-gates the signed path on BOTH
  `anthropic_models_resolved()` AND `anthropic_signed_messages_resolved()`
  (`chat_transport.rs:79-101`). To hit `/chat/completions`: parent ON, **signed sub-gate OFF**, model
  `wire_route = ChatCompletions`. If the signed sub-gate is accidentally enabled with a messages-route
  model, the request goes to `/v1/messages` and the chat mock never fires — hence the new "egress is
  `/chat/completions`" assertion.
- **Gate ORDERING is a silent trap.** Both gates are re-derived from `Feature::*` during
  `test_codex().build()` (`config/mod.rs:2832`/`:2835`). Enable the features in the builder config
  before `build()`, OR call `install_*` AFTER `build()` and before the first turn — never a bare
  install before `build()`.
- **Chat-route + gate setup is load-bearing.** Without `with_model_info_override(<chat-route Claude
  model>)` + the parent gate enabled, `client.rs:1634` routes through Responses and the chat path never
  runs.
- **Same-chunk ordering determinism.** Assert ordering ONLY via the existing direct single-buffer test
  `single_read_with_reasoning_and_content_keeps_reasoning_first` (`chat_transport.rs:1174`) or
  `streaming_sse.rs`; never via wiremock (uncontrollable TCP read splits).
- **Process-global gate races (rely on nextest process isolation, not single-binary grouping).** The
  gates are process-global `AtomicBool`s re-derived per `build()`; correctness under the all-in-one
  `core/tests/all.rs` binary depends on `cargo-nextest` running each test in its OWN process (see
  constraint 8). Run via `just test`/nextest; install the gates after `build()` just before the first
  turn; add a `#[serial_test::serial(anthropic_gate)]`-style guard if ever run under libtest.
- **Bundled test catalog is GPT-only → a `claude-*` slug PANICS `with_model_info_override`.** Override
  an existing bundled slug (`gpt-5.2`) with `wire_route = ChatCompletions` + `supports_reasoning_summaries
  = false`, or inject a custom `config.model_catalog` row; never pass a `claude-*` slug (routing depends
  on `wire_route` + gates, not the slug). See US-003 setup.
- **The egress assertion must be SERVER-level, not chat-mock-level.** A `path()` accessor on a request
  captured by the `/v1/chat/completions` mock is tautological (a misroute to `/v1/messages` 404s and is
  never captured). Assert via `server.received_requests()` (no `/v1/messages`, ≥1 `/v1/chat/completions`)
  or a zero-hit `/v1/messages` recorder stub.
- **`CachedCopilotToken` has no serde defaults** (`auth.rs:74-78`): the Option A fixture must write all
  three fields (`token`, `expires_at`, `refresh_in`), not just `expires_at`.
- **Reasoning item must persist into history** for turn-2 replay. The capstone validates the whole
  capture→persist→input→replay chain; a failure here is a real finding, not a test bug.
- **`skip_if_no_network!()` capstone has no in-sandbox gate.** The multi-turn e2e is skipped in the
  codex sandbox and `gim-home` CI is org-policy-blocked, so it provides no autonomous gate by itself —
  the gated ACs are the US-001 no-network tests. The impl member runs the capstone OUTSIDE the sandbox
  and pastes the passing output as evidence.
- **Tool determinism** — use a trivial side-effect-free tool (mirror responses-path `function_call` +
  canned `function_call_output`) so turn 2 is deterministic across platforms.
- **(Alternative-home risk) `core_test_support` reachability from an overlay leaf crate.** Only applies
  if the leaf crate is chosen over `core/tests/suite/`: `core_test_support` has no `workspace` key and
  the `codex-invariant-tests` precedent does not dev-depend on it. The RECOMMENDED `core/tests/suite/`
  home avoids this entirely.

## Suggested Decomposition

US-001 is independent and ships the verifiable no-network gated ACs first. US-002 (foundation) must
land before US-003 (capstone) can compile, and both share the chat-SSE harness + the process-global
gates, so they serialize. **Serial execution
(`/implement-with-ralph --from-plan D:/harness-efforts/codexu/.ralph/jobs/codex-anthropic-transport-us008-e2e-test/plan.md`)
is the recommended path.**

### Cluster: deterministic-assertions
- Stories: US-001
- Phase: 1
- Depends on: None
- File-overlap evidence: shared=[none]; exclusive=[`codex-copilot/src/payload.rs` `#[cfg(test)]` module; possibly `core/src/chat_transport.rs`/`anthropic_sse.rs` test modules only if a gap test is added]; risk=low
- `execution_mode` rationale: US-001 only strengthens existing inline test modules with no network or new file, so it is independent of the capstone and can run first (or in parallel with US-002 if file-disjoint), delivering the gated ACs immediately.

### Cluster: capstone
- Stories: US-002, US-003
- Phase: 2
- Depends on: deterministic-assertions (ordering preference; US-002 has no hard code dependency on US-001 but US-001 should land first to de-risk)
- File-overlap evidence: shared=[`core/tests/common/chat_sse.rs`, `core/tests/suite/chat_completions.rs`, `core/tests/common/lib.rs`, `core/tests/suite/mod.rs`, the process-global anthropic gates]; exclusive=[none]; risk=high
- `execution_mode` rationale: US-002 (chat-SSE harness + auth fixture + registration) and US-003 (the e2e that consumes them) share the new harness and the process-global gates; US-003 cannot compile until US-002 lands, so they MUST serialize.

## Open Questions

1. **Aggregate-cap semantics (operator decision needed).** The original assertion asked for a "per-item
   + AGGREGATE BYTE cap." The code (`payload.rs`) has only a per-item 8000-byte cap; the aggregate is a
   token-based history/compaction cap in a different subsystem, not a byte cap in the replay path. This
   plan asserts the per-item cap precisely. Confirm this scope, or whether the operator wants the e2e to
   also exercise the history/compaction aggregate cap (larger scope) or to ADD an aggregate byte cap (a
   production change, out of scope for a test-only task).
2. **Test home: `core/tests/suite/chat_completions.rs` (recommended) vs the overlay leaf crate.** The
   refresh recommends the suite home (patch-surface invariant-37 location, no cycle, no preflight). The
   leaf crate remains a documented alternative for minimizing the suite-dir surface, at the cost of a
   `codex-rs/Cargo.toml` member edit + the `core_test_support`-reachability preflight. Confirm the suite
   home is acceptable (default), or pre-approve the leaf-crate alternative.
3. **Overlap with `codex-rebase-debt-fix-client-copilot-fixture`.** The Option A `COPILOT_API_HOME`
   fixture is the minimal test-only slice of the removed Copilot-client test infrastructure that task
   tracks. Default: US-008 builds only the fixture it needs (test-only, no production seam) and flags the
   overlap; the lead reconciles bookkeeping.
4. **Model-override mechanism (RESOLVED by the refresh; no Claude slug).** The capstone does NOT pass a
   `claude-*` slug — the bundled test catalog (`models-manager/models.json`) is GPT-only, and
   `with_model_info_override` `.expect()`s the slug exists, so a Claude slug panics. Override an existing
   bundled slug instead: `with_model_info_override("gpt-5.2", |mi| { mi.wire_route =
   ModelWireRoute::ChatCompletions; mi.supports_reasoning_summaries = false; mi.default_reasoning_level
   = Some(<level>); })`. Routing depends on `wire_route` + the gates (not the slug), and `test_codex`
   uses the openai provider so the Copilot-side `wire_route_for` re-derivation does not run. The only
   open sub-question is the exact `default_reasoning_level` to assert; a models fixture/stub is NOT
   needed (the override + gate suffice). (The `claude-sonnet-4.6`/`claude-opus-4.8` slugs in `payload.rs`
   tests are for the unit-level replay tests, NOT this `test_codex` override.)
